n0fb6e2c27f.headline: The Reserve Fund and the National Wealth Fund lost almost 600 billion rubles in August
n0fb6e2c27f.summary: Russia's Reserve Fund decreased by 470 billion rubles and the National Wealth Fund by 123 billion rubles in August 2016.
n0fb6e2c27f.why: These sovereign funds are key to Russia’s fiscal stability and economic policy; declines may reflect budget pressures or spending needs amid economic challenges.
